title: Let Truth give your heart its place
summary: This meets the fragile craving to be confirmed by response, praise, or position. The line says worth becomes steadier when the Shabad shows the One within and Truth becomes the measure.
takeaway: Take your place in Truth, not applause.
lifeApplication: Before checking the reply, the numbers, or the room's reaction, touch the center of the chest and say the line once. Let inner sight steady you before outer feedback arrives.

source.shortMeaning: The Shabad steadies worth by revealing Truth within the heart.
source.lifeApplication: When approval tempts you, let Truth settle the heart before the room does.
